dreamteamer.title: Users
dreamteamer.description: The people and agents work is assigned to: `users`, which the owner, lead, seat and assignee fields of other modules point at, and the `teams` they form (each person reads `teams` and `led_teams`). A user links to their `contacts` record rather than merging with it, nothing here authenticates anyone, and every agent row names its human owner. Peers `contacts`, `companies` and `assets`.
